Subject: Security packet and next steps for MeteorCloud evaluation

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Thanks for walking through MeteorCloud's latency and throughput goals; the use case you described (multi-tenant customer support summaries at ~1k reqs/min) maps well to our Dedicated offering. Per our conversation, attached is the most recent SOC 2 report and a short one-pager that summarizes the controls your CISO team typically asks about.

Attachments included:
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_v1.3.pdf (attestation + control matrix)
- SOC2-summary-one-pager.pdf (CISO-friendly summary)

Proposed next steps:
1) Your security team reviews the packet (let us know any follow-up evidence needed)
2) If useful, we can set up a 30-min walkthrough with Priya (solutions engineer) to go over controls and deployment/networking options
3) Sales/Procurement coordination — if timeline looks good, we'll prepare a draft SOW and usage estimate

Could you share the preferred timeline for your security review and whether the CISO will need an exec summary? Happy to do the walkthrough as early as this week.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Sean —

Thanks for the follow-up and sending the packet. Apologies for the delay; our CISO is out this week and the security team is short-staffed. We did get the PDF and the summary. Quick update on blockers so you know where we are: 

- Our procurement like to see an explicit data retention policy tied to the deployment model (we're evaluating Dedicated vs Hosted).
- CISO asked for a 1-page summary that highlights network segmentation, key rotation/KMS, and audit log retention — they prefer top-line items up front.
- We may need a short call with your SE to confirm where logs live for Dedicated and how we surface audit events to our SIEM.

If you can send the 1-page CISO summary (or a 10-slide deck) that puts the retention and logging items first, that will speed our review. Also, can Priya do a 30-min call next Tue (May 26) at 10am PDT? That time works for our security lead.

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
Director of IT Operations
